instructions.damped: Avoid overcorrection: select the gentlest wheel angle that can keep the near road corridor reachable. The wheel setting is absolute, so repeating moderate LEFT holds that turn continuously; it is not a small incremental nudge. Use STRAIGHT to unwind when the required heading is nearly reached. Existing yaw persists briefly after a new wheel command; allow for that response lag and the next inference interval. When the nose is already turning quickly LEFT toward alignment, unwind before it rotates too far LEFT; when already turning quickly RIGHT toward alignment, unwind before it rotates too far RIGHT. If the road is already being lost, slow down rather than holding full steering and full throttle indefinitely. Choose the single wheel-and-pedal input to hold NEXT in this fictional kart game. The kart keeps moving during inference (usually about 0.25 seconds). Complete all 120 ordered gates quickly; keep the kart on the road. Each choice sets an ABSOLUTE wheel angle, not a change to the previous input. LEFT wheels rotate the nose left; RIGHT wheels rotate it right; straight wheels do not auto-align. First judge the nearby road corridor from the CURRENT nose and motion. road.road_vs_kart_deg is ROAD tangent minus NOSE: negative means the road faces RIGHT of the nose; positive means LEFT. A left bend describes the road, not necessarily the steering correction needed now. Check road.preview ego_x_m/ego_y_m at 3, 6 and 10 metres, edge clearance, actual wheel angle and yaw. Avoid steering farther toward an edge when the nose and motion already point out across it. Use future bends for speed planning; do not replace current alignment with the distant bend label. Use the physical wheel angles/radii in the choices, allowing for grip and response lag. Braking lowers speed and allows tighter turns; do not remain stopped once forward progress is safe. For next_gate, credit requires crossing its plane from negative to positive within its width. If its plane is already positive without credit, recover to its approach side before crossing forward. After rescue continue from the stopped kart. All controls remain your choice.
instructions.corridor_veto: Resolve a conflict between the CURRENT corridor and a future bend in favour of the current corridor. Negative road_vs_kart_deg means the road faces RIGHT of the nose; positive means LEFT. When the current road and the near 3/6/10 m centreline lie RIGHT, do not keep LEFT merely because the course bends left: correct RIGHT or unwind STRAIGHT as the actual yaw allows. Apply the mirrored rule when they lie LEFT. Offset side or bend direction alone does not determine the next steering input. instructions.early_margin: Choose the pedal from recovery risk as well as the wheel direction. Correct steering does not make full acceleration safe. When edge clearance is small and the nose or motion points outward, brake BEFORE leaving the road; do not wait for on_road to become false. Preserve room for a delayed next reply. Existing sideways motion takes time to arrest. While slowing, avoid tightening the turn unnecessarily. If stopped off-road, held braking and steering cannot turn a stationary kart back; resume forward motion once it is safe to recover.
